how.title: How it works
how.buy1: Create an account and log in. New accounts have a bidding limit until the first completed transaction.
how.buy2: Set your maximum bid — the system bids automatically for you (proxy bidding) and your ceiling stays secret.
how.buy3: If you lead at closing you receive the order and pay. Bids in the final minutes extend the auction (anti-sniping).
how.sell1: Request a seller account (manually verified by our team).
how.sell2: List your pigeon with pedigree, results and photos. Lots are reviewed before scheduling.
how.sell3: When sold, you receive the funds per the payout policy, minus the platform commission.
